title.en: Fable 26 — The Boy Who Cried Wolf

sentences.en: Every day he took the sheep up the hill.

sentences.en: And one day, an idea came to him.
The people in the village heard.

sentences.en: And the people were angry, and went back.
A week later, he was bored again.
And they said: this boy is a liar.

sentences.en: We will not listen to him again.
And a week later, a wolf came.
And went in among the sheep.
He shouted with all his voice.
And said: he is lying again.

sentences.en: And the wolf ate the sheep.
